text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Fubuki was in the middle of a "cute♡" competition against Vampy at the "R&A Resort". On a different day, during their free time, each of them was busy working hard on their solo activities...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『R&Aリゾート』で、
ヴァンピィと『カワイイ♡』勝負中のフブキ。
それぞれがソロ活動に勤しむ、
別の日のフリータイム──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Haaah, I'm beat~♡ Think I'll take a little break and snoop through Onii-san's profile while I'm at it~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～あ、
つっかれた～♡
ちょっと休憩がてら、
お兄さんのページでも
覗き見しちゃおっかな～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's with these numbers... why does he have so many fans?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
は？
何この数……
なんでこんなにファンがうじゃうじゃついてんの！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: The charismatic model Suzuna... and the idols from Carmina?! Huh? Even the young lady from the Mercurius Foundation?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カリスマモデルのスズナに、
アイドルのカルミナ！？
え、
【メルクリウス財団】のお嬢サマまで！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: It's ALL women in the comments!! And on posts that aren't even that impressive~!? "Picking up trash on the beach"... what even is this?! Is he some kind of honor student?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
女のコメントばっかじゃん！
しかもぜんぜんたいしたことない投稿に～～っ！？
なんだよ海岸のごみ拾いとか、
優等生かよ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If you've got that much free time, why aren't you spending it with me...!? Shitty Newb Big Bro... Loser, pathetic newb!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな時間あんなら、
なんでぼくのとこに来ないワケ……！？
ザコお兄さ
んのくせに、
ザコお兄さんのくせにぃぃ……！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAHHHH! SIS YAMA!!! LISTEN TO MEEEEE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ～～ん！　
ヤマ姉～～～！
聞いてよぉお～～！！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's this now, Fubuki? I just got my hands on some delicious wine here. ...So, what happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『……あぁ？　
なんだいフブキ。
こっちは美味いブドウ朱が手に入ったとこなんだよ。
……で、
何があったんだい？』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Newb Big Bro... he's got so many female fans even though he's a loser nobody! Why am I not his number one?! He's just a pathetic newb~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ザ
コお兄さんのくせに、
女のファンばっかなんですけどぉっ！
なんでぼくが一番じゃないワケ！？　
ザコお兄さんのくせに～っ！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I think I get the gist of it. So, are you going to mope around and give up now? Fubuki, the third daughter of the Bandy Sisters?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『……ふーん。
だいたいわかったよ。
で──
そこでウジウジして諦めんのかい？
【バンディ・シスターズ】の三女・
フブキが？』

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: I told you before. If there's something we want, we'll take it even from a crying child. That's what we, the Bandy Sisters, do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『前にも言ったろ。
欲しけりゃ泣く子からも奪うのが、
アタシら【バンディ・シスターズ】』

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: No matter who, if we desire something, we'll get it... that's our style, remember?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『相手がどこのどいつだろうと、
欲しいモンがあるなら力ずくでブン奪ってやるのが、
アタシらの流儀──
だろ？』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
う
んっ！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: If he's captivated by another woman, then you should steal his heart and make every last bit of him yours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『他の女に目を奪われてるなら、
そいつの心ごとアンタが奪い取って、
骨の髄までアンタのモンにしてやりな』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihi... Ihihihi♡ You're right! You're completely right, Sis Yama!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いひっ、
いひひひっ♡
そーだよね、
ヤマ姉の言う通りじゃん！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Sis Yama! I'm off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとヤマ姉～！　
ぼく行ってくる！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: That's right~♡ A Newb Big Bro like him has no business picking and choosing between girls♡ Besides, I'm pretty good at reeling him in~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよねぇ～♡　
ザコお兄さんごときが、
ぼく以外の女を
ヨリドリミドリなんて百年早いし♡
ぼく、
一本釣り得意なんだよねぇ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: A plan to completely steal Onii-san's heart... So many ideas are coming to mind~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さんの心、
根こそぎ奪っちゃう作戦……
イロイロ思い浮かんじゃうんですけど～♡

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, {0}, who was a little distance away, had just finished chatting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一方──
少し離れたところにいた{0}は、
ちょうどチャットを終えたところだった。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: O-N-I-I-SAN♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お・
に・
い・
さーん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Guess your ears are just as hopeless as the rest of you, huh♡ lol. Shall I blow on them a bit more then♡? Your pervert level will go through the roof~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱお兄さんって、
耳ザコなんだｗ
じゃあもっとふ～ってしてあげよっか？♡
お兄さんの変態スキル、
超絶アップしちゃうね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So... who were you chatting with?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でさ、
誰と連絡とってたワケ～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: You've been messaging Vampy~...? Hmmmmmmm???
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヴァンピィと連絡ぅ～……？
ふ～～～～～～～～ん？？？？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Okay, so it's my turn next, right? There's a challenge I wish to take on with you, Onii-san♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ次はぁ、
ぼくの番でいいよね～～？
ぼく、
お兄さんと一緒にやりたい
チャレンジがあってさ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hear up... "Please♡" See, I'm asking properly♡ You're not going to say no, are you♡?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
『おねが～い♡』
ほーら、
ぼくちゃ～んと『おねがい』してるじゃ～ん♡
まさか
イヤとか言わないっしょ～？♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi♡ Thank you~♡ As expected of a newb, so easy to manipula~... so kind♡! I'll be counting on you from now on~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっ♡　
ありがと～♡
さすがザコお兄さん、
ちょろ──
優しすぎ～♡
これからもよろしくお願いしまーす♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So, Onii-san♡ The challenge I was speaking of... is this one~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
お兄さん♡
ぼくが今からやりたいやつ、
コレなんだ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah♡ The "Enjoy a Sizzling Summer with Your Sweetheart♡ Challenge"♪ A challenge for couples♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーん♡
『恋人とアツイ夏を堪能しようチャレンジ♡』♪
カップル用のチャレンジでーす♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: For the sake of the incentive, please play the role of my lover properly♡ We have to do stuff like linking arms, feeding each other and even carrying each other♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
インセンティブのためにも、
ぼくの恋人役、
ちゃーんとやってよね♡
腕組んだり～、
あーんしたり～、
抱っこし合ったり～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Well then, first of all... let's link arms♡ To be able to link arms with a genius beauty like me... You've already peaked in life~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
まずは～……
腕組みね♡
ぼくみたいな天才びしょーじょと腕組みできちゃうとか、
人生のピーク越えちゃってるじゃ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, there's no way you can back out now♡ If I give you a big hug like this, you can't escape, right♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
言っとくけど、
今更断るなんてナシだから♡
こーやってぎゅ～ってしちゃえば、
逃げらんないよねぇ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I've always wanted to try this couples-only, overflowing fruit parfait♡ Will you feed me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ココのカップル専用山盛りフルーツパフェ、
ぼく食べてみたかったんだぁ♡
『あーん』ってしてくれる？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: We're in the middle of the challenge, so I have to take some lovey-dovey pictures and post them♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくチャレンジ参加中だから、
ラヴラヴしてる写真とって
投稿しなくちゃいけないし♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah, this red berry is delish. Come on, hurry up♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
この赤い実がいいなぁ。
ほら、
早く早く♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Aaaamuuu♡ *Munch munch*♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～む♡　
──ぱくっ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Oh! I even ate your fingers, Onii-san~♡ Hey, what should I do~? Want to nibble mines in return~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
お兄さんの指まで食べちゃったぁ～♡
ねぇどうしよ～お兄さん♡
お返しに、
ぼくも食べちゃう～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Wha-... you're completely ignoring me?! Aren't you totally glossing over my "Want to eat mines" offer here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ、
ガン無視！？
ぼくの
『食べちゃう？』
アピール、
全力でスルー！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I mean, don't just wipe your fingers with a wet towel! This is where I'd expect you to say: "For a super genius, super gorgeous girl like you, I oughta pay for everything!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってか
フツーにおしぼりで拭くなし～！
そこはもっと
『ドキッ♡　
こんな超天才美少女のためなら、
全額おごっちゃうしかないなぁ～♡』
とかなるトコじゃ～ん！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ugh, whatever! We're done here! Let's go to the next place~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～もう！　
ここはもー終わりっ！
次のとこ行くよ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Next up~♡ Let's take some lovey-dovey pool pics♡ You can swim, right, Onii-san? ...Though I guess it's fine if you can't~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お次はぁ～♡　
プールで恋人っぽい写真撮っちゃお♡
お兄さん、
泳げるよね？
……
泳げなくてもいーけど♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Here, come on! Onii-san, go, go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら！　
お兄さん、
ゴーゴー！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eh~♡ Don't you get it~? I'm hugging you from behind♡ Because we have to take a picture that looks like we're a couple~
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～♡　
わかんない～？
お兄さんの背中に抱きついてんの♡
だって
恋人っぽい写真撮らないといけないし～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: How's that♡? Pretty nice, feeling my killer curves~♡? Shall I give you an even tighter hug~♡ Come on, not gonna say anything~? I'll poke your back♡ *Poke, pokeee*
text_block_list.orig_text:
どーお♡　
ぼくのワガママバディ♡
もっとぎゅ～ってしてあげよっか～♡
ほらほら、
なにか言ったらどーなの～？　
背中
つーんつーん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh♡?! You're giving me a... princess carry?! You sure know your stuff, Onii-san?! Drone-Go! A photogenic picture's here! Take it, right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ♡　
まさかのお姫様だっこ！？
お兄さんわかってんじゃんｗ
ドロン号！　
映え写真！　
撮って撮って！

text_block_list.name: Drone-Go
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay♡ Say cheese~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほーい♡
それじゃ、
いちにの──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: へっ？

text_block_list.name: Drone-Go
text_block_list.text: Neeewb, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text: ザーコｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: UNYAAAAAAAAAH~!?
text_block_list.orig_text: うにゃぁああ～～～～！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: *Spit, spit*...! My hair's all wet! This is the worst!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぺっぺ……！　
髪の毛まで濡れた！
マジさいあく～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hey, Onii-san?! Throwing a beautiful girl like me into the water is a crime, you know! My cute hair is all wet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとお兄さん！？
びしょーじょを水にぶん投げるとかサイテーなんですけど！？
ぼくのカワイイ髪がびしょびしょじゃ～ん！！

text_block_list.name: フブキ
text_block_list.text:
……は？
ってかぼく、
泳げないワケじゃないし～
text_block_list.orig_text:
……は？
ってかぼく、
泳げないワケじゃないし～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Wait, "together" means... Hey, Newb Big Bro, you can't swim? Lol! Oh no, lol. You're a newb (lol) even more pathetic than a fish, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってか
『一緒に』ってことはぁ……
ザコお兄さん、
もしかして泳げないの？ｗ
やだ～ｗ　
ザコｗ　
雑魚なクセにおさかな以下ｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Right, lol. I'll teach you the proper "way to do it"~♡ I'm pretty good at it, you know~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そだｗ　
ちっちゃいぼくが、
おっきーお兄さんに教えてあげよっか♡
じょうずな『ヤリ方』♡　
ぼく、
けっこ～上手だよ～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Come on, Onii-san, follow my lead~♡ *Swim, swim*~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
お兄さん、
ついて来てよね～♡
すーいすい♡

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After playing in the pool for a while, Fubuki took {0} to another location.
text_block_list.orig_text:
プールで一通り遊んだあと、
フブキは別の場所へ
{0}を連れていった。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah♡! I managed to make a reservation for a premium beach seat... just the two of us♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーん♡
二人きりのプレミアムビーチシート、
予約できちゃった♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Set your gaze all around. We can sleep while looking at the sea, you know~? Come on, sit here next to me~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
周り、
見て見て。
二人で海見ながらごろ寝できるよ～？
ほら、
お兄さんも隣に座って♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? It's okay♡ You don't have to be so wary, I won't do anything♡ I mean... I'm just a weak little girl, remember♡?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？　
だいじょーぶ♡
そんなに警戒しなくても、
なにもしないってば♡
だってぼく、
非力だしぃ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Come on♡ You should lie down too, Onii-san~♡ It'll be nice for your chilled body~♡ It feels great to lie down on the sheet and soak up the hot sunshine♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほーら♡　
お兄さんも横になりなよ～♡
冷えっ冷えのカラダにはちょーどいーでしょ～♡
シートに寝そべって、
アツアツの日差し浴びちゃう感じがさ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... I'm so tired from playing so much. You should also use this time to take a nap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふわぁあ～～……
たくさん遊んで疲れちゃった。
今のうちにお昼寝しちゃいなよ～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: HO-WE-VER~♡ I won't let you sleep at night, so be prepared~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
た・
だ・
し♡
夜は寝かせないからぁ、
覚悟ヨロ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Heheh♡ You're being too cautious♡ I'm not going to do anything this time~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ♡　
お兄さんってば警戒しすぎ♡
今回はなんもしないってばぁ～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Really, honest♡ You look tired too, Onii-san. I'm going to take a short nap next to you, too♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントホント♡
お兄さんも疲れてるみたいだしぃ？
ぼくも横でちょっと寝るだけだから♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Taking care of a slave's health is a Master's job, y'know? Just go straight to sleep, okay♡ Come on, hurry up♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ドレーの体調管理も
ご主人サマの役目だしぃ？
そのまま寝ちゃっていーよ♡
ね？　
ほら早く♡

text_block_list.text:
……
お兄さん、
寝てる？　
寝てるよね？
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
お兄さん、
寝てる？　
寝てるよね？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi, lol! Sleeping soundly, even♡ Newb Big Bro, you let your guard down~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっひっひｗ
ぐっすりじゃ～ん♡
ザコお兄さん、
油断してやんの～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Now then, a chance to snap a pick of your sleeping face's here♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ～て、
寝顔ゲットチャーンス♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
The post should read: "A premium beach seat just for the two of us♡
My Newb Big Bro is tired and sleeping next to me now♡
Peace♡ Peace♡"
text_block_list.orig_text:
投稿文は
『二人きりのプレミアムビーチシート♡
ザコお兄さんは今、
疲れてぼくの横で寝てま～す♡
ぴーす♡　
ぴーす♡』
で決まり♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: With this, I'll kick those annoying women away from him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで
女どもをみーんな蹴散らして──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Toh. I should take the picture quickly before he wakes up♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っと。
お兄さんが起きる前に、
さっさと撮っちゃお♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Here I go... Neeeewb, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
いちにの──
ザーコｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Perfect shot, I got it♡ But seriously, Newb Big Bro... sleeping so defenselessly, how crazy, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
撮れた撮れた♡
にしてもザコお兄さん、
ほんっっと無防備で寝ちゃってヤバｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Right now I can do whatever I want lol. Thinking like that, even your newb face is starting to look kind of cute♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
今ならぼくの思い通りにできちゃうじゃんｗ
そー思うと、
